Ancestry Core (v1.1, RFI-native). Shared across all Echo-Diver heritages. Granted at character creation via the base ancestry item's ItemGrant advancement.

“The lions are gone. The wolves are gone. The kings are gone. We're still here. Think about what that means.”

Echo-Diver Core Traits

  • Temporal Flinch. You cannot be surprised while conscious. 1/scene, when you or an ally within 10 ft would be hit by an attack you can see, shift 5 ft as a reaction. If that moves them out of range or line of sight, the attack misses.
  • Niche Survivor. You need half the food, water, and air of a Medium creature. Reroll-lowest on Body checks against suffocation, starvation, dehydration, and extreme temperature.
  • Vault Sight. Low-light vision to 60 ft. Reroll-lowest on Perception checks for unstable structure, traps, and Spark residue.
  • Rat Inheritance. You can squeeze through 1-ft gaps without speed penalty. You can hold stillness that should not work; the GM will notice when it matters.
⟁ Per-Use Ability — Temporal Flinch
Recovery: 1/scene  ·  Action: Reaction  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke.
When an attack would hit you or an ally within 10 ft, shift them 5 ft. If that breaks range/LoS, the attack misses.
